clues: This state capital in Brazil sits where two great rivers meet. Thick green rain forest spreads out on all sides of its streets.
Here, winter is hotter than summer, a strange twist. The heat stays strong all year, with no cold days at all.
This city began in 1669 as a fort by a dark river. That small fort grew in time into a big city on the river.
Rubber once made this city the richest in South America. Rich guests from Europe brought grand art, fine homes, and high style.
Its grand opera house stands in the heart of the forest. That famed hall, the Amazon Theatre, is the mark of this city.
